text:
SupportBot: Escalation from support — customer 'MaplePay' reporting intermittent 502s on POST /v1/generate starting 2026-03-16T22:08Z. Example request-id: 01H5K7X9TQ2A. Asked for minimal repro in py/js/go + debug bundle. @Sam can you triage?

Sam: Taking it. Maria, can you ask them for a simple curl that reproduces the error and the exact response headers (mask API key)? Also need region and whether they're on Dedicated.

Maria: Sent message to MaplePay. Asked them to run this and paste full output (please redact bearer token):

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'

Include response status, body, and the request-id header.

Kevin: Posting minimal SDK snippets for customer to run (they said they prefer tiny scripts).

Python:
```python
import requests
import os

url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
resp = requests.post(url, json={"input":"repro test"}, headers=headers, timeout=10)
print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.headers.get('x-request-id'))
print(resp.text)
```

JavaScript (node fetch):
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'repro test' }),
  });
  console.log(res.status, res.headers.get('x-request-id'));
  console.log(await res.text());
})();
```

Go (minimal):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"input":"repro test"}`)))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, _ := client.Do(req)
  fmt.Println(resp.Status)
  fmt.Println(resp.Header.Get("x-request-id"))
}
```

OpsOnCall: If they can include the time window 2026-03-16T22:05:00Z -> 2026-03-16T22:20:00Z that will help. Also ask them to run the Red wood debug helper (if they have the CLI):

redwood debug-bundle --request-id 01H5K7X9TQ2A --since 2026-03-16T22:05Z --until 2026-03-16T22:20Z

If no CLI, ask them to bundle: app logs (22:05-22:20 UTC), the curl output above, and the SDK output with request-id header.

Maria: Customer returned curl output: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Response body: "backend timeout"
Header x-request-id: 01H5K7X9TQ2A
They said they are on Redwood Dedicated (eu-west-1 pool). Attached a small log snippet showing a spike in request latency around 22:09 UTC.

Ava: Noted. Can you attach the dedicated pool id and node ids? If Dedicated, include node metrics (CPU/mem) and whether autoscaler triggered. Also send the exact request payload (we need to check sequence length).

Sam: Asking MaplePay for pool id, node ids, and a redacted payload. Also requested the output of `curl -i` so we get all headers next time.

SupportBot: Great — once we have the debug bundle and the minimal scripts' outputs with the x-request-id, we'll escalate to eng-runtime with request-id 01H5K7X9TQ2A and time window. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
